name: practice
wording: an established discipline, such as domain-driven design, specification by example or event sourcing, that an agent applies by its own judgment to the work in hand; named by the industry's own name, which carries the discipline, with only cratylus's departures from it written beside it; carried to an agent as skills and named in its expertise and procedure; never a sequence of steps for the agent to follow
reason: Cratylus ships agents that apply established practices by their own judgment instead of a prescribed workflow, which had made agents act like naive juniors following instructions; the concept the agents work by had no name in the design.
